verdict.rationale: AMD's first-party ROCm software stack for the RX 9070 XT is described as primarily open-source, letting users inspect and customize it, and the ROCm Core SDK can be built from source via the open-source TheRock build system. That covers the card's compute software, but not the product as a whole, and the pack names no specific license. Missing for 10: named open license terms, source availability for the card's firmware and AMD Software/Windows driver stack, a stack that is fully rather than 'primarily' open, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: As a primarily open-source ecosystem, ROCm™ gives you the freedom to inspect, customize, and tailor the software stack to your specific needs
You can build the ROCm Core SDK from source using the open-source unified build system TheRock.
ROCm™ 7.2.1 supports the latest Radeon™ 9000 Series (RDNA™ 4) and select 7000 Series (RDNA™ 3) GPUs
